decisions.title: Full-auto = channel-agnostic spawn contract + host adapters; v1 opencode, codex fixture, rest fail-closed
decisions.rationale: gos-owned restriction-first matrix; hosts translate spawn-with-profile/outcome-stream/probe-status; desktop = client not host; per-host verification status honest.

decisions.title: Auto approvals: mechanical=auto; think/plan delegated with runner-spawned redteam evidence; archive+push always held
decisions.rationale: disposition gate + redteam_rounds + resolve-model shipped; P0 adds provenance: runner writes rounds from captured stream with hash creds; protocol stops escalate to held; plan delegation mechanical

decisions.title: Auto breaker = 3 layers: consecutive N=3, visits K=5, budget B=30; trip pauses (resume reports, explicit re-enable)
decisions.rationale: empty-return class proven (ae2e474c); stage-back ping-pong blinds consecutive-only counters; unattended needs cost cap; defaults overrideable at auto on

decisions.title: Auto evidence privacy: tracked records hash/count only; session ids, models, tails in untracked .gos/logs ledger
decisions.rationale: state.json is git-tracked (38239056); session/model/tails are machine metadata; follows D-01 logs-local boundary; hash-only is leak-free and stronger than bare-ts

decisions.title: Delivery = probe-gated adapter (v1 PR+squash); push sign-off + CI closure bind to it; SHIP termination works without it
decisions.rationale: users span local-only/plain-git/github; guards bind to existing actions; dogfood here closes 91848545; pre-merge lint, 45min watch=failure, red runs human-dispositioned

decisions.title: Auto runtime machine-local (.gos/auto.json + ledger); auto run exclusive lock; resume reports, never auto-spawns
decisions.rationale: state.json is tracked — team clones must not inherit machine behavior; D-01/D-16 machine-local precedents; .lock family prevents double loops; stub auto_mode migrates out (zero consumers)

decisions.title: Host version policy = capability negotiation: spawn-time probe + version matrix data + fail-closed + semantic predicates
decisions.rationale: hosts churn (opencode v2 announced, codex renamed full-auto); adapters touch only 3 frozen capabilities; verified status only via real dogfood; breaker catches drift probes miss

decisions.title: Danger gates = profile deny + read-union-inject + bwrap launcher (probe-gated) + escape detector; loop never in-host
decisions.rationale: bwrap/userns/env-passthrough/kernel-write-block probe-verified; plugin cannot sandbox parent — plugin=control face, desktop=observer; detach survives app close

decisions.title: Trust state outside sandbox: XDG store masked via tmpfs; breaker/lock/approval-creds verified against it, never .gos/
decisions.rationale: redteam RT1-F1: .gos/ is worker-writable (session must commit) so in-repo counters/creds/approvals are forgeable; sandbox cannot write what it cannot see
